ai.title: One Tutor, Four Study Workflows
ai.subtitle: TopKorbo AI uses the question, handwritten work, book context, or study history you choose—then explains, evaluates, and adapts.
ai.preview_subtitle: Example interaction from the implemented product
ai.access_note: AI actions require sign-in. Book-grounded tutoring is available with Pro+ reading access.
ai.capability.question.title: Question Tutor
ai.capability.question.description: Open any question for a full solution, then ask follow-ups without losing its context.
ai.capability.question.prompt: Why is option C correct? Show the reasoning step by step.
ai.capability.question.reply: I’ll start from the values in this question, apply the relevant rule, and show where the other options fail.
ai.capability.evaluation.title: Written Answer Review
ai.capability.evaluation.description: Upload handwritten work for a correct solution and mistake-by-mistake feedback.
ai.capability.evaluation.prompt: Check my handwritten solution and show the first incorrect step.
ai.capability.evaluation.reply: Your setup is correct through step 2. The sign changes in step 3; here is the corrected calculation and why.
ai.capability.reading.title: Book-Grounded Tutor
ai.capability.reading.description: Ask from a page, topic, chapter, or book and see the source pages used in the answer.
ai.capability.reading.prompt: Explain this definition using the example on this page.
ai.capability.reading.reply: I’ll begin with the page’s example, connect it to the core idea, and clearly separate any added background.
ai.capability.routine.title: Adaptive Study Coach
ai.capability.routine.description: Generate a 7-day routine, edit it in plain language, and adapt the next week from progress.
ai.capability.routine.prompt: Move Physics to mornings and add revision for weak chapters.
ai.capability.routine.reply: Physics is now in your morning focus blocks, with extra revision after topics where completion was low.

uq.title: Upload Question

uq.section.type.desc: Choose whether this is a Multiple Choice (MCQ) or Written question.

uq.section.question: Question Body (LaTeX)
uq.section.question.desc: Write your question using LaTeX syntax. Use $...$ for inline math and $$...$$ for display math.
uq.question.placeholder: Type your question here… e.g. What is the value of $\int_0^1 x^2 dx$?
uq.section.options.desc: Add 2 to 4 answer options. Mark the correct answer. LaTeX is supported in options.
uq.section.classification.desc: Categorize the question by HSC subject, paper, chapter, and topic.
